mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 0.5% triggers monetary tightening that elevates equity discount rates and reduces forward earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate collapsing consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue visibility and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rates (UNRATE > 5.0%) signal weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payrolls growth (PAYEMS > 150,000) consistently indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output and profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market contractions (HOUST < 1100) during weak residential investment cycles reduce household wealth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicate stagflationary risk that erodes corporate margins and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 240 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
